mapper.sql: select sh.shipment_id, sh.shipment_no, sh.fulfillment_id, sh.carrier_code, sh.tracking_no, sh.shipment_status, sh.shipped_at, sh.delivered_at, sh.create_by, sh.create_time, sh.update_by, sh.update_time, sh.remark, fo.order_id, fo.shop_id from shipments sh left join fulfillment_orders fo on fo.fulfillment_id = sh.fulfillment_id
mapper.select: where sh.fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} order by sh.shipment_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into shipments (shipment_no, fulfillment_id, carrier_code, tracking_no, shipment_status, shipped_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{shipmentNo}, #{fulfillmentId}, #{carrierCode}, #{trackingNo}, #{shipmentStatus}, #{shippedAt}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
